name: Nello Pagani
features: olive skin, dark hair, dark eyes, broad square face, heavy brows, compact powerful build, steady serious expression
bio: A Milanese who was world champion on two wheels and a Grand Prix privateer on four. Won the 500cc motorcycle world title for Mondial in 1949 - the very first year it was run - while also campaigning a Maserati in Formula A. One of a small handful of men to have raced at the front in both codes in the same season.
